deeplink.name: Deeplink Experience
deeplink.summary: Guides users from desktop to mobile or launches a mobile app directly via deeplink.
description: Expose a composable experience that can be triggered from buttons, banners, or automation steps.
Detects the current device and serves the best path forward – QR code for desktop users or an inline launch with graceful fallback for mobile.

props.appName: Used across dialogs and overlays so the copy can reference the product consistently.
props.deeplinkUrl: The native deeplink that will be invoked or encoded into the QR code.
props.icon: Square icon rendered at the center of the QR code to reinforce branding.
props.timeout: Seconds to wait before showing the install prompt on mobile devices.

notes.desktop: Desktop users see a branded QR code that instructs them to continue on their phone.
notes.mobile: Mobile users see a blocking spinner while the deeplink is attempted and an install dialog if the app does not respond in time.

labels.desktopDialogMessage: {appName} opens only on mobile. Scan the QR code with your phone to continue.
labels.mobileDialogMessage: We could not detect the app within {seconds} seconds. Install or try again after installing.
